ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) central region comprising approximately 70% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) patches occupying the remaining 30% at the distal tips and upper margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous white regions are localized at the distal tips and along the upper trailing edges of both lobes. These transition into low-intensity black through a zone of fine-grained mottling and streaking, while the lower and central regions are solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with a sharp interior angle and significant vertical depth relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency and variable-amplitude serration across the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by numerous jagged peaks and irregular valleys isolated against the sky background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the distal upper margins of both lobes, tapering to acute, slightly upward-turned terminal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel formations are visible at the extreme lateral terminal points of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel light-intensity linear marks are visible, particularly on the right lobe, intersecting the dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular trailing edge serration and white-pigmented scarring concentrated on the outer distal regions of both lobes.
